from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
p=Path('conversation_archive_v1')
i=json.loads((p/'index.json').read_text())
a={'initial_messages':json.loads((p/'initial_messages.json').read_text()),'entries':[json.loads((p/x['path']).read_text()) for x in i['entries']]}
print(hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(a,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest())
